_comment: DecentHead v1.0 — Product DNFT metadata following the OpenSea ERC-1155 standard.
name: DecentHead v1.0
description: DecentHead v1.0 is the first Product DNFT minted in DecentMarket. It represents the DecentHead software artifact — a Web3-native digital good licensed and distributed on-chain. Owning this token grants access to the DecentHead v1.0 artifact and its source repository snapshot.
_image_note: Replace <image-cid> with the IPFS CID returned after uploading the product image/logo. Always use the ipfs:// scheme.
_animation_url_note: Set to an ipfs:// URI when a demo video or interactive preview is available.
_properties_note: Reserved and extensible fields. 'product' holds all Product DNFT-specific metadata. Extend here rather than adding new top-level keys.

properties._layout_note: 2-D canvas placement config, e.g. { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1, rotation: 0 }
properties._model3d_note: ipfs:// URI of a glTF/GLB 3D model file

product._note: Product DNFT schema v1 — fields defined in Issue #5. Add future product fields here.
product._repo_url_note: Canonical source repository for this product artifact.
product._commit_note: Exact commit hash or GitHub permalink pointing to the version this token represents.
product._artifact_cid_note: IPFS CID of the zipped source/artifact snapshot. Replace <artifact-cid> before minting.
product._opensea_url_note: OpenSea listing URL for purchasing this token. Fill in after first mint.
